kind: new intervention; evaluation provenance: exact (twin); CPU only
command: python -m tiicee.experiments.e1.run manifest --config card --out results/E1 --figure results/figure1

seeds_by_purpose.generation: evaluation patients: stream(seed, generation, <eval_split>, case index), cases 0..n_eval-1
seeds_by_purpose.fitting: training patients for W1, W2, W2-cc and the held-out budget: stream(seed, fitting, train, case index), cases 0..n_train-1; CEE-Gate calibration patients: the next n_gate cases of the same stream
seeds_by_purpose.behavior: S_rand order: stream(seed, behavior, <eval_split>, number of tests); random prefix orders of the held-out budget: stream(seed, behavior, train, number of tests)
seeds_by_purpose.corruption: lognormal budget noise per tree level: stream(seed, corruption, <eval_split>, level); stress factor of the eligibility test: stream(seed, corruption, train)
seeds_by_purpose.montecarlo: bootstrap of the held-out bound: stream(seed, montecarlo, train, test, stratum); of the gate bounds: stream(seed, montecarlo, train, test); of the rule intervals: stream(analysis_seed, montecarlo, <eval_split>, interval number)

notes: W2-cc is W2's fitted model read class-conditionally; its predictive is W2's, so part B's W2 rows are also its rows.
Evaluation patients are the validation split: E1 selects the track and the scale variant.
Full-twin episode log loss (mc_log_loss_*) is Monte Carlo over the evaluation patients; everything else is exact.

Tables are gzipped CSV. Those under large/ are not committed; their SHA-256 is recorded here. D_final holds the final-horizon rows of D_horizon, which is what the rules and the figure step read of part D.
pending: pending interval: part C's bootstrap (c-intervals) has not been run
